text: For rice farming, maintain adequate water during important growth stages. Avoid unnecessary continuous flooding when local conditions allow better water management.
Yellowing leaves can have several causes including nutrient deficiency, water stress, pests, or disease. Check the crop and soil conditions before choosing a treatment.
For tomato plants, common problems include fungal diseases, insect pests, and nutrient deficiencies. Inspect leaves, stems, and fruits regularly.
Drip irrigation delivers water directly near plant roots and can reduce water wastage compared with some traditional irrigation methods.
Farmers should follow fertilizer recommendations appropriate for their crop, soil condition, and local agricultural guidance rather than applying excessive fertilizer.
Integrated pest management combines monitoring, preventive practices, biological methods, and appropriate control measures to manage agricultural pests.
Groundnut crops should be monitored regularly for leaf spot diseases, insect pests, and moisture stress. Good field sanitation and appropriate agricultural practices can help reduce crop problems.
Cotton farmers should regularly inspect plants for bollworms, sucking pests, and disease symptoms. Early detection can help farmers choose appropriate control measures.
Tomato plants need appropriate sunlight, water, and nutrients. Avoid excessive watering because prolonged wet conditions can increase the risk of some fungal diseases.
When crop leaves show unusual spots, curling, or discoloration, inspect both the leaves and nearby plants for insects, disease symptoms, water stress, and nutrient problems before applying treatment.

Efficient irrigation means supplying crops with the water they need while avoiding unnecessary water loss. Irrigation decisions should consider crop stage, soil condition, weather, and local recommendations.
Farmers should use fertilizers according to crop requirements and soil-test or local agricultural recommendations. Excess fertilizer can waste money and may harm soil and water quality.
